name: Password Sign-In Is Rejected
summary: The user submits password credentials that are not accepted, no session is established, and the client receives the same canonical rejected sign-in experience whether the internal cause is invalid credentials or an unknown account.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active password-enabled durable identity is presented with an invalid password

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Deliberately invalid password generated by the test setup manager and resolved by the runner. Unknown-account rejection remains a separate runtime permutation beneath this same canonical outcome.

serverInteraction.intent: Attempt password authentication and return a non-enumerating rejected result without establishing a session.

postconditions.expression: the durable identity remains present and unlocked, no successful login is recorded, account existence remains undisclosed, and auth.sign-in.unable is visible

sourceReferences.note: Unknown account and invalid password return the same public AUTH001 result while preserving distinct internal audit events. This executable UI permutation uses a known account with an invalid password and therefore expects PasswordAuthenticationFailed.
Two runtime proofs cover invalid credentials and unknown account for this canonical outcome.
Canonical rejected surface is implemented on both web and mobile with deterministic repository and source-path references.
The deterministic UI runner permutation uses the seeded durable user plus an invalid generated password; unknown-account handling remains covered by the canonical server runtime evidence.
